none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained convex differentiable f:E→ℝ with globally L-Lipschitz gradient, L>0. A global minimizer x⋆ exists with ‖x0−x⋆‖≤R, R≥0; strong convexity is not required.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each call at x returns g(x,ξ) using a fresh IID seed. The oracle is jointly measurable and unbiased: E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x). Only gradient replies are supplied. All parameters, including L,R,σ,s,ε,δ,x0, are public; f and the oracle distribution are hidden.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniformly in x, E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖²≤σ², and uniformly in x,v, E⟨v,g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)⟩²≤s²‖v‖², with 0≤s≤σ. Total variance and directional covariance bounds are supplied separately; no exponential-tail condition is imposed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CovarianceSmoothConvex.lean: IsCovarianceGradient.covariance and spec.valid; LongTails/Setups/StochasticSmoothAndConvex.lean: IsStochasticGradient.variance_integrable and variance.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real complete inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure. No dimension bound is specified.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable E-valued output X satisfying f(X)−f(x⋆)≤ε, ε>0, on the success event; no particular iterate is required.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P(f(X)−f(x⋆)>ε)≤δ for 0<δ<1, under the joint algorithm and oracle randomness, within a fixed budget counting every stochastic-gradient reply.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The smooth convex stochastic optimization formulation distinguishes a total second-moment bound from a potentially smaller directional covariance bound under IID finite-variance noise, with a high-probability objective-gap requirement.
